welcome_subtitle: WebStack Deployer for Docker will configure your local development environment automatically.
welcome_checkbox_accept: I have read the instructions and understand the requirements
welcome_credentials_note: Choose the credentials that WSDD will save in its configuration and use when deploying the prerequisite containers.
dialog_prereq_note: WSDD needs these credentials before installing the prerequisite containers for the first time in this environment.
dialog_webmin_note: This PHP version does not have saved Webmin credentials yet. They are requested only once and then reused for future projects on the same version.
main_no_projects: No projects yet. Click 'Add Project' to create one.
toolbar_terminal_ps_hint: Open PowerShell in the WSDD environment
projects_empty: No projects found. Use File -> Add Project to create one.
add_work_path_hint: Absolute path to the source directory
settings_xdebug_note: Port 9003, host.docker.internal, debug/develop mode, trigger-based start.
settings_optional_services_note: Disabled services are not deployed. When a service is enabled and saved for the first time, WSDD deploys it with this configuration.
settings_log_lines: Max log lines (decorative use, not implemented yet)
settings_auto_start: Auto-start containers on launch (decorative use, not implemented yet)
settings_docker_path: Docker Desktop path (decorative use, not implemented yet)
settings_wsl_distro: WSL distro for native Linux paths
settings_managed_storage_note: Enables WSDD-Storage and automatic runtime recovery. The task remains while WSL projects exist.
settings_apply_new_php_note: These values are applied when creating new PHP containers. Existing containers are not affected.
settings_prereq_note: These credentials are used for the base MySQL and phpMyAdmin containers managed by WSDD.
settings_prereq_runtime_note: Changing them later does not rotate existing MySQL accounts automatically; use them for first setup or a recreated base environment.
settings_webmin_credentials_note: Each PHP version has its own container and its own Webmin credentials.
settings_webmin_credentials_runtime_note: If you change these credentials after a container was already created, WSDD does not automatically rotate the user inside the existing container; it applies on the next managed rebuild.
error_project_exists: A project with this name already exists
error_domain_invalid: The domain can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, and dots.
error_managed_storage_disabled: Managed Native Linux Storage is not enabled in Settings.
managed_storage_disabled_hint: Enable Managed Native Linux Storage in Settings first.
error_project_domain_exists: A project with domain '{domain}' already exists.
confirm_delete_project: Are you sure you want to delete this project? This action cannot be undone.
confirm_restart_stack: This will restart all Docker containers. Continue?
confirm_exit: Are you sure you want to exit?
toolbox_tty_hint: Open an interactive shell inside the container
toolbox_logs_hint: Follow container logs in real time
toolbox_fix_permissions_hint: Repair runtime directory write permissions for WSL projects
toolbox_ngrok_unavailable: ngrok must be enabled, configured, and running.
deploy_php_exists: This container already exists. Use its toolbox.
deploy_php_busy: Another container or project operation is running.
projects_remove_container_confirm: Remove this PHP container and its {count} associated projects?
projects_remove_storage: Removes registrations, hosts, certificates and project volumes. Source folders are kept. Data stored only in Docker volumes is deleted.
mysql_test_primary: Primary: ephemeral Linux data inside this container.
mysql_test_isolation: This experiment uses only its own data, exposes no ports, and leaves the main MySQL unchanged.
mysql_core_primary: Primary: ephemeral Linux data inside the container.
mysql_core_isolation: Recreate freezes writes, verifies the replica, and replaces only MySQL. The initial deployment runs during normal WSDD startup.
tool_status_absent: Not in the current Docker inventory
tool_ngrok_api_status_note: Deploy verifies the Agent API; container state alone does not prove readiness.
tool_live_validation_pending: Docker integration for this service has not yet been validated end to end on a live WSDD installation.
tool_saved_pending_deploy: Saved. Run Deploy to apply this configuration.
tool_restart_with_docker: Restart with Docker unless manually stopped
tool_ngrok_api_unreachable: ngrok container is running, but its Agent API did not respond within 60 seconds.
wsl_storage_save_note: Save this section separately. It does not rewrite .wslconfig; enabling managed storage provisions WSDD-Storage and updates runtime recovery.
wsl_storage_no_changes: No WSDD storage changes to save.
wsl_storage_task_pending: Settings saved, but the recovery task still needs attention
